svg.title: Four studies: alloy, surface, frame, form.
svg.desc: Residual drift 0.0659 percent to 0.0175 percent. Ribs minus 31.10 percent, orthogonal grid plus 16.05 percent, thickness plus 25.74 percent and plus 15.03 percent with a dent. Median carbon minus 5.7 percent on 32 of 33 frames. 79 of 84 pairs within 5 percent.
